Siachen Base Camp and Ladakh Border Areas to Receive Electricity

Siachen Base Camp and key border areas in Ladakh are slated to receive electricity for the first time. The Siachen Base Camp is expected to be connected to the power grid by September 15. This initiative aims to bring power to remote and strategically important regions.
